title: Provider audit: wolfssl hash/HMAC/CMAC streaming compliance
description:
Audit src/providers/wolfssl/wolfssl_sha.c, wolfssl_hmac.c, wolfssl_cmac.c to confirm update() is already streaming (calls wc_Sha256Update / wc_HmacUpdate / wc_CmacUpdate directly) and does not accumulate in an inbuf.

Expected finding: these providers are already correct — update() feeds the wolfCrypt incremental API, finalize() calls the Final function and writes the digest/MAC.

If any provider is found to be accumulating unnecessarily, fix it.

Document findings in issue notes. Close as 'confirmed streaming' or 'fixed' accordingly.
close_reason: Audit complete: wolfssl hash/HMAC/CMAC providers are already streaming (call wolfCrypt incremental API directly); kcapi_hash already streaming; only kcapi_skcipher and wolfssl_aes_cbc/gcm needed fixes
